problem_statement: When an HTTP server responds using Transfer-Encoding: chunked, the length reported for the body fragment received (the count of decoded body bytes delivered to the response callback) is wrong: it counts the chunk framing bytes (the chunk-size line, the CRLF body terminator, and the terminal chunk) that sit in the receive buffer alongside the decoded body, so the reported fragment length is larger than the actual body size. For a single 16-byte chunked body it reports 23 bytes instead of 16. The body fragment length reported to the caller must equal the decoded body size only, not include the chunk framing.
twister_command: scripts/twister -p native_sim/native/64 -T tests/net/lib/http_client -s tests/net/lib/http_client/net.http_client -s net.http_client -O twister-out --no-clean -W
